title: Curved beam approximated by straight elements
description: Quarter-circle cantilever of radius R, tip load P perpendicular to the tip tangent. The arc is replaced by n straight Euler-Bernoulli elements; the error falls as n grows.
source: Castigliano's theorem with bending and axial strain energy: d = pi P R^3/(4EI) + pi P R/(4EA) (Roark's Formulas for Stress and Strain, curved beams)

checks.label: Tip deflection in the load direction (n = 64)
